column1: # Invented for this repository: no real player, streamer or developer is meant,
# and a likeness is chance. One row per name: flavour, TAB, name. The flavour is
# only a label (amarr, caldari, gallente, minmatar, handle, nick, title,
# epithet, tag, suffix, hyphen, apos). Rules (the server's name rule,
# start::name_shape, plus the project's): 3 to 24 letters, digits, space, - _ '
# at most 2 spaces, no leading/trailing space, unique ignoring case. The ORDER
# matters: a bot's pick starts at a hash of its group and number and walks on
# to the next free row, so appending is safe and reordering renames new bots.
